num_facilities: <int> Total number of potential facility locations that may be opened.
num_customers: <int> Total number of customers to be served.
budget_B: <int> Maximum total opening cost allowed when selecting facilities in the Maximal Covering Location Problem.
covering_demand_fraction: <float> Fraction of total demand that must be covered in the Partial Set Covering Location Problem.
covering_demand_D: <float> Minimum total covered demand required in the Partial Set Covering Location Problem.
total_demand_D_bar: <int> Sum of all customer demands across the entire customer set.
radius_of_coverage: <float> Maximum Euclidean distance between a facility and a customer for the facility to cover that customer.
facility_cost: <list[int], length num_facilities> Cost of opening each facility.
facility_coordinates: <list[list[float]], shape [num_facilities][2]> Two-dimensional coordinates (x, y) of each potential facility location.
customer_coordinates: <list[list[float]], shape [num_customers][2]> Two-dimensional coordinates (x, y) of each customer location.
customer_demands: <list[int], length num_customers> Demand quantity associated with each customer.
facility_to_customers_coverage: <dict, key: '{facility_index}'> List of customer indices that each facility can cover, where coverage means the Euclidean distance is within the coverage radius.
customer_to_facilities_coverage: <dict, key: '{customer_index}'> List of facility indices that can cover each customer, where coverage means the Euclidean distance is within the coverage radius.
